title: Nano Banana P图指令英文通用版V26.1.6（通常效果更好）
description:
Prompt: Identify all manual annotations (scribbles, arrows, circles) and handwritten text instructions in the image.

Understand & Edit: Apply the edits described by the text to the specific areas indicated by the markings.

Consistency: Ensure the edited content matches the original image's lighting, perspective, texture, and noise level (Seamless Integration).

Clean Output: Completely remove all annotation markers, text, and scribbles from the final output. The result should look like a raw, unedited photograph with no visual artifacts remaining.
remark: Nano Banana P图指令，英文通用版（通常效果更好）
